stories.title: 'We never gave up': Naqvi highlights Pakistan's peace efforts in US-Iran war at Qatar forum
stories.brief: Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi on Monday highlighted Pakistan’s mediation efforts between the United States and Iran, affirming that Islamabad “never gave up”.

stories.title: SHC rejects state appeal challenging Mahrang's acquittal in terrorism, sedition case
stories.brief: The Sindh High Court (SHC) on Monday dismissed a provincial government appeal challenging the acquittal of Baloch Yakjehti Committee (BYC) leader Mahrang Baloch in an incitement case, declaring the appeal not maintainable.

stories.title: 'Winning peace more important than winning war': Naqvi on US-Iran mediation efforts at Doha security forum
stories.brief: Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi said on Monday that "winning peace was more important than winning a war" while discussing Pakistan's mediation efforts between Iran and the United States at the 8th Global Security Forum being held in Doha.

stories.title: Sharjeel says PPP was 'last party' to support emergency in K-P
stories.brief: Transport Secretary Asad Zamin, TransKarachi CEO Zubair Channa, Yellow Line BRT Project Director Kamal Dayo and Sindh Mass Transit Authority Managing Director Behzad Memon accompanied him.

stories.title: Mission blasts off for Mars to grab a piece of its moon
stories.brief: A spacecraft is set to launch on an ambitious mission to bring 10g of Martian moon dust back to Earth.

stories.title: Musk and Anthropic pledge public share giveaways
stories.brief: Musk's announcement comes after Anthropic pledged to create a public benefit fund ahead of its blockbuster stock market listing.

stories.title: Don't fall for this - how to protect yourself from AI scams
stories.brief: Trading standards officers say AI is "super-charging" existing scams through clones and fake websites.

stories.title: Govt cuts petrol by Rs5.16, diesel by Rs7.69 for Oct 20
stories.brief: The federal government on Monday decreased the price of petrol and high-speed diesel (HSD) by Rs5.16 and Rs7.69 per litre, respectively, for October 20. The latest revision comes after the government decreased the price of petrol by Rs3.93 per litre, while keeping the price of high-speed diesel (HSD) unchanged from October 17 to October 19.

stories.title: Tariq Fazal rubbishes linking governor's rule in K-P to mineral extraction
stories.brief: Parliamentary Affairs Minister Tariq Fazal Chaudhry on Monday rubbished linking governor's rule and the imposition of an emergency in Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa (K-P) to mineral extraction in the province.

stories.title: Karachi polio case takes Pakistan’s tally to seven this year
stories.brief: Pakistan has reduced polio cases by 99.8%, according to the NEOC. According to the NEOC, Pakistan has conducted four large-scale polio vaccination campaigns this year, targeting more than 45 million children.

stories.title: Pakistan, Saudi Arabia ‘satisfied’ over progress under Makkah defence agreement
stories.brief: Pakistan and Saudi Arabia expressed satisfaction on Monday over progress under the Makkah Joint Defence Agreement and stressed the need to strengthen defence cooperation, institutional linkages and strategic coordination. On October 14, President Asif Ali Zardari received Dr Albugamy’s credentials at Aiwan-e-Sadr, reaffirming Pakistan’s commitment to Saudi Arabia’s security and defence.

stories.title: Any direct or indirect attack on Makkah alliance member state will trigger 'collective response': DG ISPR
stories.brief: The military spokesperson reaffirmed Pakistan's commitment to safeguarding Saudi Arabia's sovereignty, territorial integrity and the security of holy mosques, expressing hope that collective deterrence would prevent further aggression. Speaking about the Makkah Defence Alliance, Chaudhry said operational details of military alliances were not disclosed publicly for security reasons.

stories.title: Ex-OpenAI worker accused of planting device had Saudi support says court filing
stories.brief: The Saudi government did not immediately respond to BBC requests for comment.

stories.title: Australian MP critically injured after being hit by car in apparent attack
stories.brief: The independent politician is in hospital after what the prime minister says may have been a deliberate attack.

stories.title: Home sellers cut asking prices on 3,000 properties a day
stories.brief: More property asking prices are being cut than at any time in 15 years, data shared with the BBC shows.

stories.title: AI firm Anthropic to commit 5% of shares to fund for ‘public good’
stories.brief: It will add a further 2% of its stock to the fund for every 50% increase in its value above an undisclosed baseline.

stories.title: Australian prime minister says lawmaker critically injured by car is 'no accident'
stories.brief: A car hit an Australian federal independent lawmaker on Monday, critically injuring her in an apparent deliberate attack, Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said. The driver was arrested.(Image credit: Mick Tsikas)

stories.title: Sarina Wiegman signs contract extension to stay as England women head coach until 2029
stories.brief: Wiegman says she ‘cannot think of a better job in football’She can target three European titles in row with LionessesSarina Wiegman has extended her contract to continue as the head coach of England women for Euro 2029.

stories.title: China’s economy grows faster than forecast after AI boom boosts exports
stories.brief: The figures were better than economists had expected and up from the second quarter’s growth rate of 4.3%.
